scope: Read-only retained rows/NPY plus original OBJ. No native calls or collision/eligibility recomputation. First witness is locator order, not contact time. Triangle span is whole source triangle, not exact contact height. Relative interval subtracts swept foot range, not an independently measured person foot. Signed Float64 slope is geometric context only, not a rerun of Recast Float32 marking. Membership is read directly from saved ground IDs. 3 cm is a descriptive grouping, not a changed threshold or exemption.
